title: AI × Chem 每日精选
subtitle: 预印本、方法、数据集与实验验证的每日精选。
method: 公开来源采集、历史去重、规则筛选与模型审阅
method_note: 系统保存当日公开元数据，与历史日报核验后排除已报道事件；论文新版本、新修订及不同软件发布等可核实更新仍可入选，随后由指定模型阅读全文摘要并完成精选。

items.title: Artificial Intelligence-Assisted Dopant Discovery toward Air-Stable Sulfide Solid-State Electrolytes
items.abstract_or_text: Sulfide solid-state electrolytes (SSEs) are highly promising candidates for all-solid-state batteries (ASSBs), but the severe degradation triggered by moisture exposure remains a major obstacle to their large-scale application. Despite compositional doping could effectively enhance the air stability, there is currently no relevant screening strategy to support the efficient exploration of dopants. Herein, we develop an artificial intelligence-assisted dopant screening platform for air-stable sulfide SSEs (LPSC). Retrieval-augmented system combined with large language model could effectively prescreen the dopants that enhance both the ionic conductivity, and interfacial compatibility of the electrolyte. More importantly, the impact of dopants on the air stability of electrolytes was quantified by the minimum Gibbs free energy change () of the hydrolysis reaction, which could be predicted by a composition-based machine learning model. Guided by this strategy, several promising dopants, including BiF3, CoF3, InF3, and SnF4 were successfully identified. As a proof of concept, LPSC-BiF3 electrolyte demonstrates superior air stability, delivering a high ionic conductivity retention of 91% after exposure to air with 10% RH for 6 h. Consequently, the exposed LPSC-BiF3 electrolyte enabled excellent cycling stability in Li-In||NCM811 full cells. The proposed screening strategy significantly promotes the exploration of high-performance dopants for air-stable sulfide SSEs.
items.summary_zh: 工作构建了由检索增强系统、LLM 预筛和组成机器学习模型组成的掺杂剂发现平台，以水解反应的最小 Gibbs 自由能变化量表征硫化物固态电解质 LPSC 的空气稳定性。平台筛出 BiF3、CoF3、InF3 和 SnF4 等候选；其中 LPSC-BiF3 在 10% RH 空气暴露 6 h 后仍保留 91% 的离子电导率，并在 Li-In||NCM811 全电池中显示出良好循环稳定性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是将信息检索、语言模型与材料性质预测连接到实际电池验证的闭环案例，直接针对硫化物电解质的空气敏感瓶颈。现有验证主要集中于 BiF3 及特定湿度、时间和电池构型，其他掺杂剂的泛化性、长期稳定性和全电池适用范围仍需进一步检验。
items.abstract_zh: 硫化物固态电解质（SSEs）是全固态电池（ASSBs）的极具前景候选材料，但由水分暴露触发的严重降解仍是其大规模应用的主要障碍。尽管组成掺杂能够有效提高空气稳定性，目前尚无相关筛选策略支持对掺杂剂进行高效探索。本文开发了一个面向空气稳定硫化物 SSEs（LPSC）的人工智能辅助掺杂剂筛选平台。检索增强系统结合大语言模型可有效预筛同时提高电解质离子电导率和界面相容性的掺杂剂。更重要的是，掺杂剂对电解质空气稳定性的影响由水解反应的最小 Gibbs 自由能变化量（）量化，该量可由基于组成的机器学习模型预测。在该策略指导下，成功识别出包括 BiF3、CoF3、InF3 和 SnF4 在内的若干有前景掺杂剂。作为概念验证，LPSC-BiF3 电解质表现出优异的空气稳定性：在 10% RH 的空气中暴露 6 h 后，仍具有 91% 的高离子电导率保持率。因此，经暴露的 LPSC-BiF3 电解质使 Li-In||NCM811 全电池获得了优异的循环稳定性。所提出的筛选策略显著推动了对高性能、空气稳定硫化物 SSEs 掺杂剂的探索。
items.author_line: Zhuo Chen, Lin Hong, Xi Zhang

items.title: Per-Stage Controls and Failure Modes in a Co-Folding Virtual Screening Cascade for the Keap1–Nrf2 Interaction
items.abstract_or_text: Virtual-screening cascades assembled from co-folding and learned-affinity models are now routine, and each stage is usually trusted on the strength of its own score. We measured, stage by stage, whether those scores carry the information a practitioner would attribute to them, using the Keap1–Nrf2 protein–protein interaction and a 130,793-compound make-on-demand library as the test bed. Most measurements are negative, and none of the failure modes is specific to one of the two models tested. Two independently developed affinity models order activity-cliff pairs above chance (about 68% of 181 pairs) but carry no information about the size of the potency gap, and both couple to molecular weight; the built-in molecular-weight correction rescales without de-biasing. Neither model resolves enantiomers, including the model that generates an explicit high-confidence three-dimensional pose. Pose-model confidence is only weakly informative about geometric validity, so an explicit validity check is required rather than optional. Training-free guidance is required for stereochemical fidelity in pose generation, and diffusion steps can be halved without detectable loss. A seeded matched-decoy gate validates the pose-and-energy stage where no single physicochemical descriptor does, and the pose model reproduces all five co-crystal references below 2 Å, three of them released after its training cutoff. Single-structure MM-GBSA ordering is not validated by ensemble refinement, and the two solvation models disagree both on the ordering and on which candidates are separable at all. The control suite is released as a reusable artifact.
items.summary_zh: 工作以 Keap1–Nrf2 蛋白–蛋白相互作用和 130,793 个可按需合成化合物为测试床，逐阶段审计共折叠、学习型亲和力、构象和溶剂化评分组成的虚拟筛选流程。结果显示亲和力模型难以量化效价差、存在分子量耦合且不能区分对映体；构象置信度对几何正确性的信息量有限。作者提出并发布了含匹配诱饵门控等测试的可复用控制套件。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究不把模型分数直接等同于药物发现证据，而是系统揭示虚拟筛选级联的失效模式，并给出可操作的阶段性控制。结论来自一个靶点、两种模型和特定测试集，是否可外推至其他靶标、化学空间和实验活性测定仍需验证。
items.abstract_zh: 由共折叠和学习型亲和力模型构成的虚拟筛选级联如今已成常规，而每个阶段通常都因其自身分数而被信任。我们逐阶段测量这些分数是否确实携带实践者通常赋予它们的信息，以 Keap1–Nrf2 蛋白–蛋白相互作用和一个包含 130,793 个可按需合成化合物的化合物库为测试床。大多数测量结果为阴性，且没有一种失效模式是所测试两种模型中某一种所特有的。两个独立开发的亲和力模型都能以高于随机的水平对活性悬崖对进行排序（181 对中约 68%），但并不携带效价差距大小的信息，且二者都与分子量耦合；内置的分子量校正只能重缩放而不能去偏。两种模型均不能分辨对映体，包括能够生成显式高置信度三维构象的模型。构象模型的置信度对几何有效性仅有较弱的信息量，因此显式有效性检查是必需的，而非可选项。构象生成中的立体化学保真度需要无需训练的引导，且在未检测到损失的情况下可将扩散步数减半。一个带种子的匹配诱饵门控验证了构象与能量阶段，而没有任何单一物理化学描述符能够做到这一点；该构象模型还能以低于 2 Å 的误差重现全部五个共晶参考，其中三个在其训练截止日期之后发布。单一结构 MM-GBSA 排序未被系综精修验证，两种溶剂化模型在排序以及哪些候选物根本可分离上均不一致。该控制套件作为可复用工件发布。

items.title: Dynamic Parameter Screening for Accelerated Mechanistic Analysis
items.abstract_or_text: Mechanistic studies are essential for the continued advancement of the chemical sciences however; classical approaches remain laborious and material intensive. Graphical reaction analysis techniques such as RPKA and VTNA have substantially reduced this burden, yet the time and resources required to comprehensively study increasingly complex reactions remain high. Medium- and high-throughput batch and flow kinetic methods have been developed to further streamline data acquisition, but their widespread adoption is limited by the need for specialized equipment or expertise. Here we introduce dynamic parameter screening (DPS), in which a single batch reaction is monitored continuously while sequential reagent and catalyst additions are used to probe kinetic impacts of multiple species within one experimental setup. Using the palladium-catalyzed Kumada–Tamao–Corriu cross-coupling as a model system, we compared DPS with traditional one-factor-at-a-time approach across three catalytic systems (PdCl2(dppf)·CH2Cl2, PEPPSI-iPr, and XPhos Pd G2). DPS afforded essentially identical qualitative and quantitative (kinetic modeling) conclusions except for the case of XPhos Pd G2. This latter system exhibited multiple kinetic regimes where the traditional approach revealed the global impact of reagent concentrations, whereas DPS provided complementary, higher-resolution insight into reagent effects within a specific kinetic regime. The insights obtained from DPS guided a simple slow-dosing strategy that markedly improved reaction rates even at reduced catalyst loadings. DPS therefore provides a practical, low-barrier route to high-resolution kinetic information that is fully compatible with conventional modeling, broadening access to mechanistic understanding in resource-limited settings.
items.summary_zh: 作者提出动态参数筛选（DPS）：在单次批式反应连续监测过程中，依次加入试剂和催化剂，同时探测多种物种的动力学影响。以 PdCl2(dppf)·CH2Cl2、PEPPSI-iPr 和 XPhos Pd G2 催化的 Kumada–Tamao–Corriu 偶联为例，DPS 通常与逐一变量法给出一致的定性和定量结论，并据此提出低催化剂负载下的慢加料提速策略。
items.why_it_matters_zh: DPS 有望以常规反应设备降低机制研究的时间和物料成本，同时保留可与传统动力学建模衔接的实验读出。XPhos Pd G2 出现多动力学区间，说明该方法反映的是局部条件效应，复杂反应仍应与传统全局扰动实验互补使用。
items.abstract_zh: 机制研究对化学科学的持续进步至关重要，但经典方法仍然费时且消耗大量物料。RPKA 和 VTNA 等图形反应分析技术已大幅减轻这一负担，但全面研究日益复杂反应所需的时间和资源仍然很高。中高通量批式和流动动力学方法已被开发以进一步简化数据获取，但其广泛采用受到专用设备或专业知识需求的限制。本文介绍动态参数筛选（DPS），即连续监测单次批式反应，同时通过依次加入试剂和催化剂来探测多个物种的动力学影响。我们以 palladium-catalyzed Kumada–Tamao–Corriu cross-coupling 为模型体系，在 PdCl2(dppf)·CH2Cl2、PEPPSI-iPr 和 XPhos Pd G2 三个催化体系中比较 DPS 与传统逐一变量方法。除 XPhos Pd G2 的情况外，DPS 给出了本质上相同的定性和定量（动力学建模）结论。后一个体系表现出多个动力学区间：传统方法揭示了试剂浓度的全局影响，而 DPS 则对特定动力学区间内试剂效应提供了互补且更高分辨率的洞见。DPS 获得的洞见指导了一种简单的慢加料策略，即使在降低催化剂负载量时也显著提高了反应速率。因此，DPS 为获取高分辨率动力学信息提供了一种实用、低门槛且与常规建模完全兼容的途径，拓宽了资源有限条件下获得机制认识的机会。
items.author_line: Dylan J. Pyle, Finn Bork, Wesley McNutt, Ekaterina Trushina, Joshua S. Derasp, Sara M. Guzman, Jan Dijkmans, Robert Van Putten, Bertrand Schweitzer-Chaput, Matthew Mower, Jason E. Hein

items.title: Mechanical State Selection in Mechanochemical Bond Activation.
items.abstract_or_text: Mechanochemical reactivity provides a distinctive mode of energy input, wherein mechanical force performs work on molecular structures to access reactivity beyond conventional thermal activation. Yet a fundamental understanding of how transient mechanical impacts translate into productive molecular activation remains lacking, particularly under the stochastic conditions of ball milling. By promoting direct homolytic bond scission, mechanoradical chemistry provides an ideal platform to interrogate the role of mechanical force in triggering chemical reactions. However, the resulting highly reactive radical species are often short-lived and elusive, making their formation and reactivity difficult to quantify. Here we use a mechanoradical-chain C-S coupling reaction to amplify otherwise transient initiation events into a measurable kinetic response. Time-resolved kinetics reveal a pronounced force-dependent induction period, while theoretical calculations show that productive C-I homolysis requires a specific loading trajectory. These findings indicate that mechanical force does not simply promote bond cleavage in proportion to its magnitude; rather, individual impacts sample a distribution of mechanical states, with only a small subset being competent for chemical activation. This selective sampling of mechanically competent states provides a mechanistic basis that controls the initiation, propagation and extinction of mechanoradical chains, enabling sustained out-of-equilibrium radical reactivity under intermittent mechanical driving, including with otherwise inaccessible insoluble poly(disulfides) in a diffusion-limited setting.
items.summary_zh: 该研究以 mechanoradical-chain C-S 偶联放大短寿命机械自由基的起始事件，并结合时间分辨动力学与理论计算，分析球磨中机械冲击如何触发化学键活化。结果表明有效 C-I 均裂需要特定加载轨迹，球磨冲击仅有少数机械状态能启动化学活化；这一状态选择控制了自由基链的起始、传播和终止。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究为间歇机械驱动下的非平衡自由基反应提供了可检验的机制框架，也说明机械化学的反应性不能仅按施力大小理解。证据来自特定 C-S 偶联和计算加载轨迹，对其他机械化学体系的普适性仍有待实验证实。
items.abstract_zh: 机械化学反应性提供了一种独特的能量输入方式，其中机械力对分子结构做功，从而获得超越常规热活化的反应性。然而，特别是在球磨的随机条件下，人们仍缺乏对瞬态机械冲击如何转化为有效分子活化的基础理解。通过促进直接均裂断键，机械自由基化学为探究机械力触发化学反应的作用提供了理想平台。然而，所得高反应性自由基物种通常寿命很短且难以捕捉，使其形成和反应性难以定量。本文使用一种 mechanoradical-chain C-S 偶联反应，将原本瞬态的引发事件放大为可测量的动力学响应。时间分辨动力学显示出显著的力依赖诱导期，而理论计算表明，有效的 C-I 均裂需要特定的加载轨迹。这些发现表明，机械力并非按其大小成比例地促进断键；相反，单次冲击会采样一组机械状态，只有其中很小一部分能够胜任化学活化。这种对机械胜任状态的选择性采样提供了一个机制基础，它控制机械自由基链的引发、传播和终止，使间歇机械驱动下持续的非平衡自由基反应成为可能，包括在扩散受限环境中原本难以进入的、不溶性 poly(disulfides) 的反应。
items.author_line: Taoyong Wang, Hao Li, Xuanyang Ni, KaKing Yan

items.title: Disentangling element‑specific pathways in solvothermal formation of platinum-group metal complex solid solutions
items.abstract_or_text: Platinum‑group metal (PGM) complex solid‑solution nanoparticles exhibit unique catalytic properties due to a homogeneous atomic‑scale distribution of multiple elements within a single crystalline phase. Despite their importance, the mechanisms governing their solvothermal formation remain poorly understood. Here, we investigate the solvothermal synthesis of multicomponent Pt–Ir–Pd–Rh–Ru nanoparticles by in situ powder X‑ray diffraction, enabling time‑resolved monitoring across a wide compositional space of ternary and quaternary alloys. Lattice‑parameter evolution confirms incorporation of all elements into a common fcc phase with a systematic iridium deficiency. Crystallite size correlates with elemental heat of fusion, identifying lattice energy as a key parameter controlling particle growth. Formation pathways are strongly element specific: Pd‑free systems form homogeneous alloys directly, whereas Pd‑containing systems follow a two‑step mechanism involving initial Pd‑rich crystallisation and diffusion‑controlled alloying when Pt is present. Pd without Pt yields inhomogeneous multiphase products, contradicting the assumption that Pd seeding is required for homogeneous PGM alloy formation. Overall, this study demonstrates how in situ X‑ray diffraction can accelerate materials discovery while also providing general mechanistic insight into multicomponent solvothermal alloy formation.
items.summary_zh: 作者用原位粉末 X 射线衍射追踪 Pt–Ir–Pd–Rh–Ru 三元和四元纳米合金的溶剂热形成，发现所有元素进入共同 fcc 相但存在系统性 Ir 缺失，晶粒尺寸与元素熔化热相关。无 Pd 体系可直接形成均匀合金；含 Pd 体系则先结晶为富 Pd 相，在有 Pt 时再经扩散合金化；没有 Pt 的 Pd 体系形成不均匀多相产物。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究以时间分辨实验证据拆解多组分 PGM 固溶体的元素特异性形成路径，为催化纳米合金的可控合成提供了机制线索。考察的体系限于给定元素组合和溶剂热条件，催化性能与形成机制之间的直接定量关联尚未在摘要中呈现。
items.abstract_zh: 铂族金属（PGM）复合固溶体纳米颗粒因多种元素在单一晶相中均匀的原子尺度分布而表现出独特催化性质。尽管其重要性突出，控制其溶剂热形成的机制仍知之甚少。本文利用原位粉末 X 射线衍射研究多组分 Pt–Ir–Pd–Rh–Ru 纳米颗粒的溶剂热合成，从而能够在宽广的三元和四元合金组成空间内进行时间分辨监测。晶格参数演化证实所有元素均并入一个共同的 fcc 相，但存在系统性的铱缺失。晶粒尺寸与元素熔化热相关，表明晶格能是控制颗粒生长的关键参数。形成路径具有强烈元素特异性：无 Pd 体系直接形成均匀合金，而含 Pd 体系在有 Pt 时遵循两步机制，包括先形成富 Pd 晶体，随后发生扩散控制的合金化。没有 Pt 的 Pd 则产生不均匀多相产物，这与 Pd 成核是形成均匀 PGM 合金所必需的假设相矛盾。总体而言，本研究展示了原位 X 射线衍射如何加速材料发现，同时也为多组分溶剂热合金形成提供了普遍的机制认识。
items.author_line: Andreas Dueholm Bertelsen, Raul Castellano Perdomo, Magnus Nørgaard Kløve, Anders Bæk Borup, Bo Brummerstedt Iversen, Andreas Kolding Bertelsen

items.title: Screening Natural and Modified Nucleobases to Create Alkylation-Resistant Nucleic Acids Toward Sensing Applications
items.abstract_or_text: Alkylating agents play critical roles in medicine and chemical defense but also pose significant hazards by modifying DNA and disrupting cellular function. Their reliable detection is therefore critical, yet current analytical methods are often limited by poor selectivity, need for extensive sample preparation, or poor compatibility with complex matrices. Nucleic acid sensors, such as aptamers, offer a promising route to achieve selective sensing. However, alkylation of nucleobases can compromise DNA three-dimensional structure and binding abilities. To address this limitation, we sought to develop DNA sequences that are resistant to alkylation. We first evaluated the reactivity of modified nucleobases toward a panel of alkylating agents. Although the N7 position 2 of guanosine and N3 position of adenosine have been reported to be among the primary alkylation sites, their analogues 7-deaza-2′-deoxyguanosine and 3-deaza-2′-deoxyadensoine were still found to be reactive. In contrast, 7-deaza-2′-deoxyinosine and 7-deaza-2′-deoxyadenosine were resistant to all alkylating agents tested. Using these resistant nucleobases as substitutes for all guanosine and adenosine residues, respectively, we screened polymerases and found that Therminator DNA Polymerase enabled enzymatic synthesis of fully alkylation-resistant DNA. This work establishes a chemical framework for the development of robust, DNA-based sensors for alkylating agents in biomedical and defense applications.
items.summary_zh: 研究筛查天然和修饰核碱基对多种烷基化剂的反应性，发现 7-deaza-2′-deoxyinosine 与 7-deaza-2′-deoxyadenosine 对所有测试烷基化剂均具抗性。将其分别替代 DNA 中全部鸟苷和腺苷残基后，作者筛到可合成完全抗烷基化 DNA 的 Therminator DNA Polymerase。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作从核碱基化学和酶促合成两端建立了耐烷基化 DNA 的实现路线，可能提升复杂基质中核酸传感器的耐受性。摘要未给出具体传感器性能、序列依赖性或复杂样品中的选择性数据，应用价值仍需在完整器件中验证。
items.abstract_zh: 烷基化剂在医学和化学防御中发挥关键作用，但也会通过修饰 DNA 并扰乱细胞功能而造成重大危害。因此，对它们进行可靠检测至关重要，但当前分析方法常受限于选择性差、需要大量样品前处理或与复杂基质兼容性差。核酸传感器，如适配体，为实现选择性传感提供了有前景的途径。然而，核碱基的烷基化会损害 DNA 的三维结构和结合能力。为解决这一限制，我们试图开发耐烷基化的 DNA 序列。我们首先评估了修饰核碱基对一组烷基化剂的反应性。尽管据报道鸟苷的 N7 位点2 和腺苷的 N3 位点是主要烷基化位点之一，它们的类似物 7-deaza-2′-deoxyguanosine 和 3-deaza-2′-deoxyadensoine 仍被发现具有反应性。相比之下，7-deaza-2′-deoxyinosine 和 7-deaza-2′-deoxyadenosine 对所有测试的烷基化剂均具有抗性。以这些耐受核碱基分别替代所有鸟苷和腺苷残基后，我们筛查聚合酶并发现 Therminator DNA Polymerase 能够酶促合成完全耐烷基化的 DNA。这项工作为开发用于生物医学和防御应用的稳健 DNA 传感器提供了化学框架。
items.author_line: Olamilekan Joseph Ibukun, Makenzie R. Walk, Jennifer M. Heemstra

items.title: Explicit and Parallelised Octupole and Hexadecapole Moment Interactions in Flexible Smooth Particle Mesh Ewald
items.abstract_or_text: Long-range electrostatic interactions have long been known to be important in the accurate simulation of biomolecular systems and molecular crystals. Despite this fact, these interactions are absent in many machine learning force fields aiming to improve upon classical potentials. In the worst cases, this omission can lead to serious discrepancies with experimental results. FFLUX is a machine learning force field that predicts atomic energies and multipole moments up to the hexadecapole moment on-the-fly during molecular dynamics simulations. The predicted multipole moments are fed into an adapted smooth particle mesh Ewald algorithm allowing long-range electrostatic interactions to be calculated. Here we present refactoring of the Ewald routines and a new implementation of routines handling interactions involving octupole and hexadecapole moments. The new implementation leads to a speed-up of up to 10.5 times in serial compared to our previous implementation. Additionally, a hybrid parallelisation scheme using a combination of Message Passing Interface and OpenMP is made available to these high-electrostatic-rank calculations. This parallelisation offers speed-ups of up to two orders of magnitude, improving the feasibility of bulk simulations with high-rank electrostatic interactions using FFLUX force fields.
items.summary_zh: 作者重构 FFLUX 力场的 Ewald 例程，并实现 octupole 与 hexadecapole 矩相互作用的显式计算及 MPI/OpenMP 混合并行。新实现相对原串行程序最高提速 10.5 倍，混合并行在高阶静电计算中最高可达两个数量级加速，从而提高含长程高阶多极静电相互作用的大尺度模拟可行性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作针对机器学习力场中常被忽略的长程高阶静电项给出可扩展实现，可服务于生物分子和分子晶体模拟。性能提升针对 FFLUX 与所报告的实现环境；相对其他力场的精度收益和实际体系中的端到端效率仍需独立比较。
items.abstract_zh: 长期以来，人们已知长程静电相互作用对生物分子体系和分子晶体的准确模拟十分重要。尽管如此，许多旨在改进经典势能的机器学习力场仍缺少这些相互作用。在最严重的情况下，这种遗漏会导致与实验结果的严重偏差。FFLUX 是一种机器学习力场，可在分子动力学模拟过程中即时预测原子能量以及最高至 hexadecapole moment 的多极矩。预测的多极矩被输入一个经改造的 smooth particle mesh Ewald 算法，从而能够计算长程静电相互作用。本文提出了对 Ewald 例程的重构，以及处理涉及 octupole 和 hexadecapole moment 相互作用例程的新实现。与我们之前的实现相比，新实现的串行速度最高提高了 10.5 倍。此外，还为这些高静电阶数计算提供了结合 Message Passing Interface 和 OpenMP 的混合并行化方案。该并行化方案最高可带来两个数量级的加速，提高了使用 FFLUX 力场进行具有高阶静电相互作用的体相模拟的可行性。
items.author_line: Matthew L. Brown, Michael K. Bane, Paul L. A. Popelier, Paul L.A. Popelier

items.title: Evaluating a Lightweight Neural Network for Aggregate Isotope Distribution Prediction
items.abstract_or_text: Isotope distribution prediction is an important part of mass spectrometry data analysis. A variety of strategies have been developed, including brute-force polynomial methods and Fourier-transform (FT) convolution methods. Here, we present a novel neural network (NN) approach to isotope prediction. These NN-based tools are distributed in a new package, IsoGen, alongside FT-based tools. We show that NNs perform as well as existing approaches when predicting isotope distributions for molecules with natural isotope ratios. We then demonstrate the capability of NNs for transfer learning, a method by which existing models that have been trained to perform one task can be reused as a starting point to train models to perform a second task. Here, a NN that has been trained to predict isotope distributions for molecules with natural isotope ratios can be retrained to predict distributions for molecules with perturbed isotope ratios. We also demonstrate that these training distributions do not need to be produced theoretically but may be extracted from experimental data where the underlying isotopic composition is not known. Overall, NNs provide a robust method for isotope prediction that can be extended to applications where the isotope distributions can be measured but not easily predefined.
items.summary_zh: 工作提出并发布 IsoGen，将神经网络同 Fourier-transform 卷积方法一起用于质谱同位素分布预测。神经网络在天然同位素比体系中与既有方法表现相当，并可通过迁移学习适配扰动同位素比；训练分布还可从未知底层同位素组成的实验数据中提取。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该方法尝试把同位素分布预测从固定理论分布扩展到数据驱动、可迁移的情形，对复杂质谱分析有潜在价值。摘要表明其天然丰度条件下仅与现有方法相当，针对真实复杂样品、计算成本及迁移学习稳健性的优势仍需更完整的基准评估。
items.abstract_zh: 同位素分布预测是质谱数据分析的重要组成部分。人们已开发出多种策略，包括暴力多项式方法和 Fourier-transform（FT）卷积方法。本文提出一种新颖的用于同位素预测的神经网络（NN）方法。这些基于 NN 的工具与基于 FT 的工具一起发布在新软件包 IsoGen 中。我们表明，在预测具有天然同位素比的分子的同位素分布时，NN 的表现与现有方法一样好。随后，我们展示了 NN 的迁移学习能力；迁移学习是一种可将已经训练完成某项任务的模型重新用作训练第二项任务起点的方法。在此，一个已训练用于预测具有天然同位素比的分子同位素分布的 NN，可以重新训练以预测具有扰动同位素比的分布。我们还证明，这些训练分布不必由理论产生，也可以从底层同位素组成未知的实验数据中提取。总体而言，NN 为同位素预测提供了一种稳健方法，并可扩展至能够测量同位素分布但不易预先定义的应用。
items.author_line: John G. Pavek, Josiah Grimes, Brian L. Frey, Nathan V. Welham, Lloyd M. Smith, Michael T. Marty

items.title: Polymer-Assisted One-Dimensional Dissolution in N‑Methylformamide Unlocks Highly Ordered Hybrid Bragg-Stack Clay-Poly(Ethylene Glycol) Oxygen Barriers
items.abstract_or_text: One-dimensional (1D) dissolution is a gentle and thermodynamically driven process that enables the spontaneous and utter delamination of layered materials into nematic suspensions of individual high aspect ratio nanosheets. This process is primarily known and extensively explored for aqueous systems. Examples of 1D dissolution in organic solvents are scarce and require selected organocations or complexation of the interlayer cation. This work demonstrates synergistic delamination of synthetic sodium fluorohectorite (NaHec; Na0.5inter [Li0.5Mg2.5]oct tet O10F2) in N-methylformamide (NMF) using poly (ethylene glycol) (PEG), which concomitantly acts as a complexing agent driving delamination and as the polymer matrix for a composite. Upon spray coating, the polymer is directly incorporated into a highly ordered hybrid Bragg-stack nanocomposite. The performance as a gas barrier was investigated for a range of PEG chain lengths [MW = 200, 400, 1500, 10000 g mol-1] using O2‑transmission rate measurements. With increasing MW, substantially reduced oxygen permeabilities (23°C, 75% r.h.) were observed, reaching values as low as 0.029 cm3 µm m‑2 d‑1 bar‑1, demonstrating the power of non-aqueous preparation of NaHec-PEG hybrid Bragg-stack nanocomposites.
items.summary_zh: 作者展示 PEG 协同促进合成 sodium fluorohectorite（NaHec）在 N-methylformamide（NMF）中一维剥离，同时让 PEG 充当络合剂和复合材料基体。喷涂后形成高度有序的 hybrid Bragg-stack 纳米复合物；随 PEG 分子量增加，氧渗透率显著下降，最低达到 0.029 cm3 µm m‑2 d‑1 bar‑1。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 非水一维剥离将层状黏土的温和解层、聚合物复合和气体阻隔性能整合在同一制备路径中。性能仅在给定温湿度和 PEG 分子量范围内报告，制造放大、机械性质及不同气体阻隔表现仍需补充。
items.abstract_zh: 一维（1D）溶解是一种温和且由热力学驱动的过程，能够使层状材料自发且完全地解离为由单片高长宽比纳米片组成的向列悬浮液。该过程主要在水相体系中为人所知并得到广泛研究。在有机溶剂中，一维溶解的例子很少，且需要选定的有机阳离子或对层间阳离子的络合。本工作展示了使用 poly (ethylene glycol)（PEG）在 N-methylformamide（NMF）中对合成 sodium fluorohectorite（NaHec；Na0.5inter [Li0.5Mg2.5]oct tet O10F2）的协同剥离；PEG 同时充当驱动剥离的络合剂和复合材料的聚合物基体。经喷涂后，聚合物直接并入高度有序的 hybrid Bragg-stack 纳米复合材料。使用 O2-transmission rate 测量，考察了一系列 PEG 链长[MW = 200, 400, 1500, 10000 g mol-1]的气体阻隔性能。随着 MW 增大，观察到氧渗透率大幅降低，在 23°C、75% r.h. 下最低达到 0.029 cm3 µm m‑2 d‑1 bar‑1，显示出以非水方法制备 NaHec-PEG hybrid Bragg-stack 纳米复合材料的能力。
items.author_line: Max Stevenson, Alexandra Jourdain, Felix Uhlig, Sabine Rosenfeldt, Meike Kuhn, Eva M. Herzig, Josef Breu

items.title: Dynamic Covalent Approaches to Responsive Electropores for Iontronics
items.abstract_or_text: Regulating ion transport across biomimetic membranes is fundamental to the design of adaptive neuromorphic and iontronic systems. Electroporation provides a powerful means to establish conductive pathways without biological pore-forming agents, yet these pores are inherently transient and stochastic, limiting their ability to achieve non-volatile, reconfigurable conductance. Here, we show stable, chemically responsive electropores in nanoparticle-surfactant bilayers assembled via dynamic covalent diketoenamine chemistry. The lifetime of electropores is modulated via electrical stimuli, allowing the bilayer to emulate synaptic behaviors ranging from short-term plasticity to long-term potentiation. While interfacial jamming structurally stabilizes conductive pathways against line-tension-induced closure, amine-mediated bond exchanges provide a distinct chemical trigger to unjam interface and actively reseal the pores. By evaluating a series of 1-alkylamines, we find that additive lipophilicity governs the interfacial chemo-response, with high partition coefficients being essential for triggering pore resealing. By integrating photo-caged polymeric amines into the surrounding oil phase, we achieve in situ optical resetting of transmembrane ion conductance, bypassing physical intervention and slow passive diffusion of exogenous chemical triggers. Our findings establish dynamic covalent nanoparticlesurfactants as a robust architecture for engineering stable, responsive electropores in biomimetic membranes, providing a foundation for adaptive neuromorphic and iontronic systems.
items.summary_zh: 研究利用动态共价 diketoenamine 化学组装的 nanoparticle-surfactant 双层，构建可由电刺激调节寿命、可模拟短时程可塑性至长时程增强的稳定 electropores。胺交换可解除界面拥塞并重封孔道，且作者通过 photo-caged polymeric amines 实现跨膜离子电导的原位光学重置。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作把动态共价界面化学引入仿生离子通道，为可重构离子电子器件和神经形态材料提供了新架构。器件证据主要是模型双层和突触样行为；长期循环、尺度化集成及与真实生物膜的可比性仍待验证。
items.abstract_zh: 调控跨仿生膜的离子传输是设计自适应神经形态和离子电子系统的基础。电穿孔提供了一种无需生物孔形成剂即可建立导电通路的强大方式，但这些孔本身具有瞬态和随机性，限制了其实现非易失、可重构电导的能力。本文展示了在通过动态共价 diketoenamine 化学组装的 nanoparticle-surfactant 双层中形成的稳定、化学响应性 electropores。electropores 的寿命可通过电刺激调节，使该双层能够模拟从短时程可塑性到长时程增强的突触行为。界面拥塞在结构上阻止导电通路因线张力诱导的闭合，而胺介导的键交换则提供了不同的化学触发，可解除界面拥塞并主动重新封闭孔道。通过评估一系列 1-alkylamines，我们发现添加剂亲脂性控制界面的化学响应，高分配系数是触发孔重封所必需的。通过将 photo-caged polymeric amines 整合进周围油相，我们实现了跨膜离子电导的原位光学重置，避开了物理干预以及外源化学触发剂缓慢的被动扩散。我们的发现确立了动态共价 nanoparticle-surfactants 作为构建稳定、响应性 electropores 的稳健架构，为自适应神经形态和离子电子系统奠定基础。
items.author_line: Jiho Kang, Paul D. Ashby, Ahmad K. Omar, Thomas P. Russell, Brett A. Helms

items.title: Cumulative Charge as a Workload-Aware Comparison Coordinate for Pulsed High-Current OER Stability
items.abstract_or_text: The interpretation of electrode degradation under dynamic electrolysis is complicated by the fact that degradation rates expressed per unit time depend not only on the degradation response but also on the electrochemical workload imposed during the test. Here, we investigate this effect for porous NiFe OER electrodes operated in an alkaline gas-diffusion-electrode half-cell configuration under pulsed galvanostatic operation at 1-3 A·cm-2. Two pulse protocols, corresponding to 86% and 96% active operation time, were evaluated using 36 electrode tests from two independent deposition batches. Degradation was quantified both per unit elapsed time and per cumulative areal charge using iR-corrected electrode potentials, sample-level regression, random-effects pooling, and batch-aware statistical analysis. In the time domain, the degradation rate increased substantially with current density, from 19.2 ± 4.7 to 53.4 ± 23.6 mV·h-1 for the 86% active-operation protocol. In contrast, the charge-normalized voltage loss remained approximately constant at 5.6-6.2 mV·(kC·cm-2)-1 over 1-3 A·cm-2 for the same protocol. The 96% protocol showed a similar overall reduction in apparent current-density dependence after charge normalization, although the 2 A·cm-2 condition exhibited a distinct deviation. Furthermore, at 3 A·cm-2, increased non-linearity, signal variability, and post-electrolysis structural damage indicated a transition to a failure-prone operating regime in which linear charge-normalized degradation was no longer sufficient to describe electrode behavior. Our results demonstrate that elapsed-time degradation rates can overstate apparent current-density and duty-cycle effects during pulsed high-current electrolysis. The charge-normalized voltage loss therefore provides a useful workload-aware descriptor for comparing degradation within the stable operating regime, while high-current failure processes require separate consideration.
items.summary_zh: 作者以两批独立制备的 36 个多孔 NiFe OER 电极为对象，比较脉冲恒电流操作下按时间与按累计面电荷归一化的降解描述。时间域降解速率随电流密度显著升高，但在 1–3 A·cm-2、86% 活性运行方案中，电荷归一化电压损失约为 5.6–6.2 mV·(kC·cm-2)-1；3 A·cm-2 则表现出非线性、波动和结构损伤。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究提出累计电荷这一工作负荷感知坐标，可避免将脉冲高电流电解的时间归一化衰减率误读为纯粹的电流密度效应。其适用范围限于稳定运行区间和所测试的 NiFe 电极构型；高电流失效机制仍需单独建模。
items.abstract_zh: 动态电解条件下电极降解的解释较为复杂，因为以单位时间表示的降解速率不仅取决于降解响应，也取决于测试中施加的电化学工作负荷。本文研究了在 1-3 A·cm-2 脉冲恒电流操作下，于碱性气体扩散电极半电池构型中运行的多孔 NiFe OER 电极。采用两种脉冲方案，分别对应 86% 和 96% 的有效运行时间，并使用来自两个独立沉积批次的 36 次电极测试进行评估。使用 iR 校正电极电位、样品层面回归、随机效应汇总和考虑批次的统计分析，分别以单位经过时间和单位累计面电荷量化降解。在时间域中，对于 86% 有效运行方案，降解速率随电流密度显著升高，从 19.2 ± 4.7 增至 53.4 ± 23.6 mV·h-1。相比之下，在相同方案中，1-3 A·cm-2 范围内按电荷归一化的电压损失约保持在 5.6-6.2 mV·(kC·cm-2)-1。96% 方案在电荷归一化后也显示出表观电流密度依赖性的类似总体降低，尽管 2 A·cm-2 条件表现出明显偏离。此外，在 3 A·cm-2 下，增加的非线性、信号变异性和电解后结构损伤表明体系进入了一个易失效运行区间，其中线性的电荷归一化降解已不足以描述电极行为。我们的结果表明，在脉冲高电流电解中，经过时间降解速率可能夸大表观电流密度和占空比效应。因此，按电荷归一化的电压损失为在稳定运行区间内比较降解提供了一个有用的、考虑工作负荷的描述符，而高电流失效过程则需要单独考虑。
items.author_line: Oleg I. Zaitsev, Etienne Berner, Gustav K.H. Wiberg, Matthias Arenz

items.title: Hydridoaluminastibanes: A New Class of Al–Sb Bonded Main-Group Compound
items.abstract_or_text: Reactions of an Al(I) center with Sb–Cl, Bi–Cl and, notably, Sb–H reagents afford a family of Al(III) complexes featuring structurally characterized, pnictogen–halide and –hydride bonds. The Sb–H reaction is particularly striking, simultaneously forging Al–Sb and Al–H bonds to give the first hydridoaluminastibane establishing the previously unknown Al(Sb)(H) functional group. These results introduce pnictogen hydride oxidative addition as a new strategy for Al–Sb bond formation and expands the reactivity landscape of hydrostibination.
items.summary_zh: 作者使 Al(I) 中心分别与 Sb–Cl、Bi–Cl 和 Sb–H 试剂反应，得到含 pnictogen–halide 或 pnictogen–hydride 键的结构表征 Al(III) 配合物。Sb–H 反应同时构建 Al–Sb 和 Al–H 键，首次获得 hydridoaluminastibane，并建立此前未知的 Al(Sb)(H) 官能团。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究扩展了主族 Al–Sb 键构建和 hydrostibination 的反应性图谱，并提出 pnictogen hydride oxidative addition 这一合成策略。摘要聚焦结构与反应发现，尚未说明该官能团的反应范围、稳定性边界或功能性应用。
items.abstract_zh: Al(I) 中心与 Sb–Cl、Bi–Cl，尤其是 Sb–H 试剂的反应，得到了一系列 Al(III) 配合物，其中具有经结构表征的 pnictogen–halide 和 –hydride 键。Sb–H 反应尤其引人注目：它同时形成 Al–Sb 和 Al–H 键，得到首个 hydridoaluminastibane，确立了此前未知的 Al(Sb)(H) 官能团。这些结果引入了 pnictogen hydride oxidative addition 作为形成 Al–Sb 键的新策略，并扩展了 hydrostibination 的反应性图谱。
items.author_line: Elizabeth A. McKenzie, Gabriel J. Jobin, Mitchell A. MacEachern, A. Dina Dilinaer, Saurabh S. Chitnis, Marcus W. Drover

review.note: 基于候选文件中的题名、摘要与公开元数据审阅。入选项均按相关性、创新性、方法可信度和验证强度排序；未纳入仅计算预测且缺乏验证、摘要不完整或证据不足的候选。
